title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the Valorant match between regnum4games and Backed by Nobody in the Spike Series Convergence EMEA - DACH Group B, initially scheduled for November 29, 2026 at 12:00 PM ET.

This market will resolve to "regnum4games" if regnum4games win Map 1 against Backed by Nobody.

This market will resolve to "Backed by Nobody" if Backed by Nobody win Map 1 against regnum4games.

If the match begins but is not completed, and Map 1 is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on the completed Map 1. 

If Map 1 is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50. 

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before December 13, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of November 29, 2026 at 12:00 PM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://vlr.gg. However, if https://vlr.gg has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.
